narr: A passing shortwave and remnant MCS outflow was enough to initiate some scattered afternoon showers and storms. Impacts were not widespread, however training storms in an environment with 1000 J/kg MUCAPE and 1.7-1.9 PWAT was sufficient for very localized flooding.
ev: Report of flooded roadway at intersection of Freedom Way and Main Street in Weirton.
lsr: Flooded roadway near Freedom Way and Main Street in Weirton. Time estimated based on 911 centers report.
